case.prompt: Создай уровень Geometry Dash с блоками разной высоты, группами шипов и обязательными прыжками. Выполни все численные требования и сохрани проходимость всего уровня.

messages.content:
Build a Geometry Dash level from a SMALL FIXED LIBRARY, all four sections in one response. Return ONLY {s1:{pairs:[...],extra:...},s2:...,s3:...,s4:...} matching the schema. Choose types, not coordinates. The compiler expands your exact choices in order with 5 empty tiles after each pair, then the extra obstacle; no substitutions, count repair, search, or fallback. Local origin is 0, then the announced section offset is added. Whole-prefix search from x=0 checks every transition and the actual minimum jumps.
Contributions of ONE pair:
triple_pair: 6 spike tiles, 0 blocks, 2 double groups, 2 triple groups, 0 tall blocks, 1 tight gap, width 8.
stairs: 0 spikes, 2 blocks, 0 double/triple groups, 1 tall block, 1 tight gap, width 6.
tower_triple: 3 spike tiles, 1 block, 1 double group, 1 triple group, 1 tall block, 1 tight gap, width 6.
Each pair is intended to need two jumps. Extras: single_spike adds 1 spike; double_spike adds 2 spikes and 1 double group; triple_spike adds 3 spikes, 1 double and 1 triple group; block adds 1 block; tall_block adds 1 block and 1 tall block. A separate extra is intended to add one jump. Only actual search confirms jump counts. Names and enum values are literal.
The NEW-SECTION requirements below are residual counts: previous accepted objects have ALREADY been subtracted. Satisfy these additional counts with this section's choices. You do NOT need to repeat cumulative whole-level counts inside every new section. All four sections may be revised. Never change the original requirements. Respect the required number of pairs, extra choice and maximum local right edge. A repeated rejected plan is not a useful revision.
This is JOINT planning: there is NO accepted immutable prefix. Every response is a complete four-section plan. The validator checks all original requirements and the FULL path; a failed map is never exported as success. During revision you may change ANY section. Plan counts across the WHOLE level; never repeat whole-level counts in every section. Fixed section slots: [{"section":1,"origin":11,"localRightEdge":38,"pairs":3,"extraChoices":["none"]},{"section":2,"origin":50,"localRightEdge":38,"pairs":3,"extraChoices":["single_spike","double_spike","triple_spike","block","tall_block"]},{"section":3,"origin":89,"localRightEdge":38,"pairs":3,"extraChoices":["none"]},{"section":4,"origin":128,"localRightEdge":40,"pairs":3,"extraChoices":["single_spike","double_spike","triple_spike","block","tall_block"]}]
The exact compiler and library are unchanged. You choose all types and orders. Only actual search proves the minimum jumps and path.

Repair an existing Geometry Dash library plan. Fixed geometry; 5 empty tiles after each pair, then optional extra. Only names/types/order are chosen. Each section's origin, bounds, pair count and extra enum are fixed.
triple_pair: spikes=6, blocks=0, doubleSpikes=2, tripleSpikes=2, tallBlocks=0, tightGaps=1, width8.
stairs: spikes=0, blocks=2, doubleSpikes=0, tripleSpikes=0, tallBlocks=1, tightGaps=1, width6.
tower_triple: spikes=3, blocks=1, doubleSpikes=1, tripleSpikes=1, tallBlocks=1, tightGaps=1, width6.
Extras single_spike:1 spike; double_spike:2 spikes,1 double; triple_spike:3 spikes,1 double,1 triple; block:1 block; tall_block:1 block,1 tall. none adds nothing. Names are literal enum values. No coordinates, portals or new types. Normal cube, built-in ground, fixed speed and gravity. Only full-level proxy search proves playability and actual minimum jumps, which is minimized over all successful paths. Pair counts alone do not prove jumps.
Return ONLY one section plan {pairs:[...],extra:...} for s2; the compiler replaces exactly that section. Every other section stays byte-for-byte unchanged.
A shared controller accepts only literal proposals preserving already-confirmed checks, rejects an earlier failed-path position, and rejects a larger numeric deficit when reachability status is unchanged. A neutral preparation may be retained, but is not counted as an improvement. Rejected candidates do not replace the current retained plan. Never change the original requirements. Stop after a full success. Do not repeat rejected choices. No repaired plan is supplied.
